# Day One Citizen

> Plain-English guide to Star Citizen for brand-new players — buying the game, checking your PC can run it, installing it, learning the controls, and getting through your first flight, all with no jargon and no gatekeeping. Written by veteran backer Doc_Flanigan for someone who has never even seen the game. Unofficial fan site; not affiliated with or endorsed by Cloud Imperium Games or Roberts Space Industries.

## Pages

- [Overview](https://dayonecitizen.com/): Start here — what Star Citizen is, what the 'Verse and UEC mean, and where to begin.
- [Day One Citizen Guide](https://dayonecitizen.com/day-one-citizen): The core twelve-part walkthrough, from "is it worth buying?" to your first quantum jump.
- [Is Star Citizen Worth Buying?](https://dayonecitizen.com/day-one-citizen/worth-buying): An honest look at whether the game is right for you before you spend anything.
- [Is Star Citizen on Steam?](https://dayonecitizen.com/day-one-citizen/is-star-citizen-on-steam): No — it is sold only at robertsspaceindustries.com for Windows PC; consoles, Game Pass, and Steam Deck answered honestly.
- [Do You Have to Buy Ships With Real Money?](https://dayonecitizen.com/day-one-citizen/ships-real-money): No — one $45 package is the only required purchase; every other ship can be earned in-game with aUEC.
- [Your First Ship](https://dayonecitizen.com/day-one-citizen/first-ship): Why the Aurora Mk II from the $45 pack is the right first ship for most new players, compared honestly with the Mustang Alpha.
- [When Is the Next Wipe?](https://dayonecitizen.com/day-one-citizen/next-wipe): No wipe is currently announced — what survives (everything bought with real money, account UEC) and what resets (aUEC, in-game items).
- [System Requirements](https://dayonecitizen.com/day-one-citizen/system-specs): Whether your PC can run Star Citizen, in plain terms.
- [Buying the Game](https://dayonecitizen.com/day-one-citizen/buying-the-game): How to buy Star Citizen and what a starter package includes.
- [Pledge vs. Purchase](https://dayonecitizen.com/day-one-citizen/pledge-vs-purchase): Why buying is called "pledging" and what that means for you.
- [Choosing a Starter Package](https://dayonecitizen.com/day-one-citizen/starter-package): Comparing the cheapest ways to get into the game, including Aurora Mk II vs Mustang Alpha.
- [Installing the Game](https://dayonecitizen.com/day-one-citizen/install): Step-by-step install walkthrough.
- [The RSI Launcher](https://dayonecitizen.com/day-one-citizen/rsi-launcher): Setting up and using the official launcher.
- [First Launch](https://dayonecitizen.com/day-one-citizen/first-launch): What to expect the first time the game loads.
- [Keybinds & Controls](https://dayonecitizen.com/day-one-citizen/keybinds): The keyboard and mouse controls you actually need on day one.
- [Your First Day](https://dayonecitizen.com/day-one-citizen/first-day): What to do once you spawn in for the first time.
- [Getting Around](https://dayonecitizen.com/day-one-citizen/getting-around): Moving through stations, cities, and space as a new player.
- [Your First Flight](https://dayonecitizen.com/day-one-citizen/first-flight): Taking off, flying, and making your first quantum jump.
- [Beyond the Basics](https://dayonecitizen.com/beyond-the-basics): Next-step guides once you are past your first flight — friends, food and survival, inventory, shops, ship equipment, CCU chains, redeem codes, and quantum travel.
- [Adding Friends](https://dayonecitizen.com/beyond-the-basics/adding-friends): How to add friends in Star Citizen, join a party, and play together.
- [Food, Drink & Survival](https://dayonecitizen.com/beyond-the-basics/food-drink-survival): Why your character needs to eat and drink, and how to stay healthy.
- [Inventory Management](https://dayonecitizen.com/beyond-the-basics/inventory-management): How local inventory, personal inventory, and ship storage actually work.
- [Party Management](https://dayonecitizen.com/beyond-the-basics/party-management): Creating a party, inviting friends, and staying together in the 'Verse.
- [In-Game Shops Directory](https://dayonecitizen.com/beyond-the-basics/shops-directory): Where to buy ships, weapons, armor, and components in-game, city by city.
- [Ship Equipment](https://dayonecitizen.com/beyond-the-basics/ship-equipment): Upgrading your ship's weapons, shields, and components as a new player.
- [CCU Chains](https://dayonecitizen.com/beyond-the-basics/ccu-chains): What a CCU is, how upgrade chains work, and whether they are worth it.
- [Redeem Codes & Referral Bonus](https://dayonecitizen.com/beyond-the-basics/redeem-codes): What codes exist in Star Citizen, how referral codes work, and how to start with 50,000 UEC.
- [How to Quantum Travel](https://dayonecitizen.com/beyond-the-basics/quantum-travel): Spooling the quantum drive, picking a destination, and making your first long-distance jump.
- [Report a Bug](https://dayonecitizen.com/report-a-bug): How to gather evidence, search the Issue Council, file a report, and follow up.
- [Free Fly Events](https://dayonecitizen.com/free-fly-events): When Star Citizen is free to try, how to join, and what you can do during a Free Fly.
- [Star Citizen Referral Code](https://dayonecitizen.com/referral-code): The referral code STAR-GCQJ-N6NC, exactly where to enter it during RSI signup, and how the free 50,000 UEC bonus works — no purchase required.
- [Glossary](https://dayonecitizen.com/glossary): Plain-English definitions of Star Citizen terms, acronyms, and 'Verse slang.
- [Quick Reference](https://dayonecitizen.com/quick-reference): Mobile cheat sheet — the essential keybinds (on foot, ship flight, capacitors) and which Stanton shop sells weapons, armor, components, mining gear, and ships.
- [Tools](https://dayonecitizen.com/tools): Handy references and utilities for new players.
- [Fact Check](https://dayonecitizen.com/fact-check): Searchable ledger of fact-checked Star Citizen claims — referral bonus, wipes, funding, events, Squadron 42 — each with a verdict, an official Cloud Imperium source, and the date last verified. Free for creators to cite.
- [About](https://dayonecitizen.com/about): Why this site exists, the referral disclosure, and what "unofficial fan site" means here.

## German pages (Deutsch)

- [Star Citizen kaufen](https://dayonecitizen.com/de/star-citizen-kaufen): Star Citizen gibt es nur direkt bei robertsspaceindustries.com — Starterpaket ab 45 US-Dollar, keine Keys, kein Steam. Schritt-für-Schritt-Kaufanleitung auf Deutsch.
- [Lohnt sich Star Citizen 2026?](https://dayonecitizen.com/de/lohnt-sich-star-citizen): Die ehrliche Antwort — ja zum Einstiegspreis für Fans offener Weltraum-Sandboxes, nein für alle, die ein fertiges Spiel erwarten.
- [Welches Starterpaket?](https://dayonecitizen.com/de/starterpaket): Die Empfehlung für neue Spieler — das Citizen Starter Pack für 45 US-Dollar mit der Aurora Mk II, plus der CCU-Upgrade-Pfad erklärt.
- [Ist Star Citizen auf Steam?](https://dayonecitizen.com/de/star-citizen-auf-steam): Nein — nicht auf Steam, PS5, Xbox oder im Game Pass. Nur Windows-PC, verkauft direkt über robertsspaceindustries.com.
- [Musst du Schiffe für Echtgeld kaufen?](https://dayonecitizen.com/de/echtgeld-schiffe): Nein — ein 45-US-Dollar-Paket genügt; alle Schiffe können im Spiel mit aUEC erspielt werden. Mit ehrlicher Pay-to-win-Einordnung.
- [Gibt es Star Citizen auf Deutsch?](https://dayonecitizen.com/de/auf-deutsch): Offiziell nur Englisch — deutsche Texte gibt es nur über inoffizielle Community-Sprachdateien; auch RSI-Website und Anmeldung sind englisch.
- [Empfehlungscode (Deutsch)](https://dayonecitizen.com/de/referral-code): Der Empfehlungscode STAR-GCQJ-N6NC bringt 50.000 UEC Startguthaben ohne Kauf — mit deutscher Schritt-für-Schritt-Anleitung durch die englische RSI-Anmeldung.

## Key facts

- Star Citizen is an always-online sci-fi sandbox built by Cloud Imperium Games; players pilot ships, explore planets, trade, fight, mine, and salvage in one persistent universe.
- Star Citizen is the highest-funded game in crowdfunding history, having raised over $1 billion.
- New accounts that enlist with a referral code start with a 50,000 UEC (United Earth Credits) in-game bonus.
- This site's core content is a twelve-part "Day One Citizen" walkthrough covering everything from system requirements to a new player's first flight.
- The site launched as o7citizen.com and was renamed to dayonecitizen.com in April 2026; the old domain still redirects to it.
